- Walmart FY 2024 revenue growth  
  = (642,637 − 605,881) / 605,881 × 100% ≈ 6.07%

- Walmart’s fiscal 2024 revenue growth: about 6.1%  
- Oracle’s fiscal 2024 revenue growth: about 6.0%  

Walmart’s revenue grew slightly faster than Oracle’s in their respective fiscal year 2024 periods.

ANSWER: Walmart ≈ 6.1% FY 2024 revenue growth vs. Oracle ≈ 6.0% FY 2024 revenue growth (on each company’s own fiscal year basis).
